claims.claim: Across the four batch 1 verdict files, 9 runs pass, 9 fail and 3 are invalid; the invalid runs are ep7 on ml40 and ep1 and ep28 on mf4090.
In mf4090 batch 1 segment B, ep18, ep22, ep24 and ep29 pass the batch verdict, and ep24 has the highest maniptrans_sr of the four at 0.962.
The final checkpoint of ep16 on mf4090 fails the batch verdict: chord_sr and maniptrans_sr are both 0, and its ADD-AUC of 0.255 is below the do-nothing baseline of 0.266.
ep16's training summary on mf4090 has no NaN, and its final mean episode length (about 119) is much shorter than that of the other four segment B runs on mf4090, which range from about 374 to 552.

Among the 27 runs in the error table, exactly five (ep12, ep8, ep23, ep24 and ep26) have an MP-SR of at least 0.95, and among the listed features, path length and total rotation have the most negative Spearman correlations with MP-SR.

For ep1 on mf4090, the first checkpoint with non-finite parameters is the one at 50,001,920 steps. In the pace file, apart from the first interval (4 min 53 s, which includes compilation), the 10M-step intervals up to 40M steps are 3 min 17 s to 3 min 20 s, the interval ending at 50,001,920 steps is 6 min 22 s, and the following intervals are about 7 min 20 s.
The ep28 watcher on mf4090 stopped the run with fc_stop after two consecutive non-finite checkpoints, at 50,001,920 and 60,002,304 steps.

In the truncated ml40 runs, L0 (ep1 with the v0.4.0 importer) has non-finite parameters from its 30,001,152-step checkpoint on and its 10M-step intervals grow from 3:18 to over 7 minutes, while L1 (ep1 with the #185 importer) has finite parameters in all six checkpoints and intervals of 3:09 to 3:10.

With the v0.4.0 importer, the box supports of the iron (ep7), vacuum (ep1) and squeegee (ep28) sequences are built as boxes with half extents (0.5, 0.5, 0.5), while the #185-patched importer builds the iron sequence's tabletop with half extents (0.42, 0.141, 0.005).
The support.py at aee95f2 has the same md5 as at v0.4.0 and builds a Cube from its size attribute alone, while the version at 8c778f905c differs.
Under the v0.4.0 geometry, the ep7 iron is embedded more than 5 mm in the tabletop cube in all 896 frames, about 49 cm deep at frame 0.

With seeds 43 to 46, R1 diverged in 2 of 4 runs, R3' in 0 of 4 and R2 (fp32 storage) in 2 of 4; H3 and H4 are rejected, and H1' has a one-sided Fisher p of 0.2143, so the registered rule calls for extending to 8 seeds.
All four R3' smokes reach a mean episode length of at least 64 and a return of at least 2.37, while the R1 and R2 runs that did not diverge stay near an episode length of 51 with a return near -3.7.

fc_run.sh appends in-flash-chord's output to runs/logs/<run>.log and writes the container's docker logs to the per-segment .s<N>.log; in the importer check every #185 run has exactly one mount line in its .log and every .s1.log has none.

In the fp32 R2 run with seed 43, the non-finite entries of the 486-dimensional input normalization statistics cover the wrist, object and joint position and velocity blocks, the future joint and palm position deltas, the position parts of the hand-in-object and target-in-object poses, and the target history, while every 6D orientation block and the future root position block stay finite.

The updated kit changed KIT_MANIFEST.json, tools/pack_submission.py and the Track 2 README, and the README now says the packer converts the evaluator's poses to the released frame when the evaluator uses a different world frame.
With all eight seeds, R1 diverged in 5 of 8 runs and R3' in 0 of 8; the one-sided Fisher p is 0.0128, so H1' is supported under the registered rule, while H3 and H4 remain rejected.
Among the seed 47 to 50 smokes, the v0.4.0-importer runs with seeds 47, 48 and 49 end with 5892 non-finite parameters, the seed 50 run ends finite, and all four #185-importer runs end finite.
L3, the ep1 run with the v0.4.0 importer and fp32 observation storage, has non-finite parameters from its first checkpoint at 10,000,384 steps.
The final importer check covers five queues and finds 27 valid runs and no invalid ones.
In curriculum stage 1 (35M to 60M steps), the mean episode length is about 3.6 for both v0.4.0-importer ep1 runs, about 204 for the #185 ep1 run and about 318 for the #185 ep28 run.
ep24's final checkpoint on mf4090 passes the batch verdict.
ep16's final checkpoint on mf4090 passes the batch verdict.
L1, the ep1 run with the #185 importer, has non-finite parameters in its final checkpoint.
Most of the R3' smokes diverged.
With all eight seeds, H1' is not supported because the one-sided Fisher p stays above 0.05.
